rationale: The previous robot candidate struggled with line-following, evidenced by a maximum error of 0.065515 and multiple line loss events. To address these issues, I adjusted the kp value to 0.7 to reduce overshooting, increased the wheel track to 0.18 for better stability, and repositioned the sensors to enhance their effectiveness. These changes should improve line-following performance and reduce line loss events, leading to a higher score in the next evaluation.
